data.name: Ethyana
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ethya' meaning fertility and 'An' meaning mother, Ethyana represents the goddess of fertility and motherhood in Hindu mythology. This name holds a deep significance for Hindu families and is often given to girls born in the auspicious Hindu lunar month of Shukla Paksha (bright fortnight), especially during the Harvest Festival season.
